title: Zeira bar Chiya bar Ashi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat, chapter 7, halakhah 2, with the additional historical folio locator 28a, disagreeing with Rabbi Zeira. Hyman suggests that the word Zeira was corrupted from the preceding word zorea, “sowing,” in the phrase “liable for sowing.” Zorea was written twice and afterwards became Zeira.

notes.text: The repetition of zorea and its change into Zeira are Hyman’s proposed explanation of the name; no fresh scan adjudication is claimed.
